_note: Only relationships stated by the publisher or a primary source are listed. Each edge must cite evidence. Types: extends, imports, part-of, aligns-with, superseded-by, references, follows-pattern-of.

categories.label: Formal dependency
categories.description: Imports, extensions and modules stated by the publisher.

categories.label: Explicit mapping
categories.description: Alignments or mappings published by a publisher or primary source.

categories.label: Shared standards & vocabularies
categories.description: References, reused patterns and lineage stated by a primary source.

categories.label: Documented technical connection
categories.description: Format support, interfaces, dependencies, training data and evaluation stated in publisher documentation. Not a demonstrated integration in your context.

categories.label: Editorially proposed
categories.description: Used together in the same layer of an atlas reference stack. Derived from use cases, not stated by publishers.

types.label: extends
types.description: Specialises or builds on the target's concepts.

types.label: part of
types.description: Published as a module of the same standard or suite.

types.label: aligns with
types.description: Provides an alignment or mapping to the target.

types.label: integrated into
types.description: Content was integrated into, or is continued by, the target.

types.label: references
types.description: Uses identifiers or terms from the target.

types.label: supports the format
types.description: Reads or writes the target format, as stated in the publisher's documentation.

types.label: provides an interface to
types.description: Ships a documented bridge or interface to the target.

types.label: depends on
types.description: Requires the target to run, as stated by the publisher.

types.label: documents integration with
types.description: Documents a supported integration with the target (e.g. a supported benchmark).

types.label: was trained on
types.description: Model trained on the target dataset, as stated by its authors.

types.label: was evaluated with
types.description: Evaluated on the target benchmark, with results reported by its authors.
